FAQs
Have questions?
We’ve got answers
What is an Everyday Growth Account?
The Everyday Growth account combines the flexibility of a traditional chequing account with the added bonus of earning interest on your balance.
Does Haventree Bank offer high-interest savings accounts?
Haventree Bank offers the Everyday Growth Account, a hybrid account that combines flexibility of a traditional chequing account with the added bonus of earning interest on your balance. Your money stays accessible while continuing to grow.
How is interest calculated on my account?
Interest is calculated daily based on your account’s closing balance at the end of each business day. The interest you earn is deposited into your account on the first day of every

balance at the end of each business day. The interest you earn is deposited into your account on the first day of every month.
Is my Everyday Growth Account insured?
Yes. Haventree Bank is a member of the Canada Deposit Insurance Corporation CDIC. Eligible deposits in your Everyday Growth Account are insured up to $100,000 per insured category, subject to coverage limits. You can learn more on the CDIC website .
How many Everyday Growth Accounts can I have?
You can open up to 8 Everyday Growth Accounts with Haventree Bank, including individual and joint accounts.
